name: 5-Minute Creamy Coleslaw
description: A quick creamy coleslaw made with bagged slaw mix and a simple tangy dressing.
recipeInstructions: Whisk together the mayonnaise, apple cider vinegar, white vinegar, sugar, salt, black pepper, and celery seeds to make the dressing.
Combine the dressing and coleslaw mix in a large bowl. Stir until all the vegetables are coated. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to eat.
